preparation: Reuse unchanged Pass93 gateway33, complete ordered host program; never live nested interception.
scope: Canonical lookup33, descriptor57D6, first-candidate success, selected AD0A=1 handler; all inherited table/code/frame/pointer/output/child guards.
chronology: Acquire only outermost accepted concrete windows; suppress accepted descendants while a parent is active. One list in actual root-entry order, not concatenated streams.
transaction: Current ancestry selects without oracle; entry CPU/RAM bound to preparation. Named scope rejection declines; unexpected proof errors propagate. Existing commit/validation chain unchanged.
reads: Owned gateway/predicate and inherited canonical read laws unchanged and independently revalidated by Pass93.
proof: All roots complete registers/flags/PC/SP, fullRAM, every ordered write, stack residue, DMA/filesystem/services. Surviving old roots exact journal/state/RAM; each absent old root must lie inside an accepted parent.
final_CPU: Exact root post-CPU plus deterministic identical guest intervals/suffix establish final equality by induction; runner has no public final-CPU snapshot. Final RAM directly compared.
timing: Single sequential run per mode, same binary/input/Execution analysis. Oracle acquisition timed separately and excluded from end-to-end native runs. No statistical wall-time speedup claim.
